messages.subject: Survival Model - Interpreting the intercept
parts:
Hello,

I have a frailty survival model with no covariates or exposures which can be written in INLA as:

f1<- inla.surv(fu_time, status) ~ 1 + f(id, model = "iid" ...)

where id is an integer index of cohort sampled locations. My question is in this instance can the
intercept be interpreted as the baseline hazard rate. E.g if the intercept is 0.073 can we interpret this
as the hazard rate of 7.3 per 100 (0.073 x 100) person-years at risk?

Thank you.
